notes: `רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם` fuses on *is large* under rule 30 rather than leaving `יָדַיִם` unrepresented beside a rendered construct; the head is `רָחָב`, which carries the content (rule 23).

*anything* is one target token carrying both `כֹּל` and `דָּבָר`, so the pair shares one unit, headed on the governing construct, and the *of* is the relation `מַחְסוֹר` bears to that rectum (rules 19, 23, 30).
`שָׁם` is unrepresented because the *there* the ASV writes is the existential frame's own dummy, which rule 50 keeps with `אַיִן`.
